snippet.title: Mysarium – Demo Launch Trailer 🌱 Cozy Terrarium Sandbox
snippet.description:
Welcome to your digital corner of peace. ✨ Step into the world of Mysarium, a one-of-a-kind cozy game developed by Sanobusiness.

In this cozy sandbox, you will have the power to create and nurture wonderful miniature ecosystems. Explore the charm of a terrarium game where beautiful, fully customizable tiny worlds in glass come to life. Whether you are looking for a relaxing game to unwind after a long day or a chill game to keep in the background, Mysarium is the perfect indie game for you.

Let yourself be carried away by a magical atmosphere and discover:

Creative sandbox: Unleash your imagination without limits or pressure.

Hand-drawn game & Illustrated game: Every element is crafted with meticulous detail in a unique, handmade graphic style.

Lofi game & Mindfulness game: Find your rhythm thanks to a relaxing soundtrack, also ideal as a pomodoro game for focused study or work sessions.

Plant game & Decoration game: Collect plants, place decorative elements, and watch your little ecosystem thrive.

The great attention to detail makes every session an experience of pure well-being.

🌿 THE DEMO IS ALIVE! 🌿
The moment has finally come: celebrate the demo launch with us! Download the free steam demo now and start creating your very first terrarium.

If you love our project and want to support the development of this little world, add it to your wishlist:
👉 WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4749980/Mysarium_Demo/

🌟 Share Mysarium with your community!
If you are a creator and want to share this relaxing journey, check out our Press Kit for logos, screenshots, and info:
👉 PRESS KIT: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12L9VCpxhxIP_32G4X39IvHVKU0xPhswA
